# Regis

> Regis is an online store in Nigeria that sells curated watches from known brands, delivered across Nigeria. Customers browse watches at regiswatch.com and place their orders on WhatsApp.

## Key pages

- [Shop all watches](https://regiswatch.com/shop): every watch with photos, colours and prices in naira
- [Terms](https://regiswatch.com/terms): terms of sale
- [Refunds](https://regiswatch.com/refunds): refund information
- [Privacy](https://regiswatch.com/privacy): privacy policy
- [Sitemap](https://regiswatch.com/sitemap.xml): every watch page

## How ordering works

1. Pick a watch and colour on regiswatch.com.
2. Send the order on WhatsApp and pay Regis directly.
3. Follow packaging and delivery from your account. Orders earn credits for the next purchase.
